The test image shows a very young soybean seedling at the cotyledon stage, lying on/collapsing at the soil surface. Key features:
- **Affected part**: Seedling at soil level (hypocotyl/cotyledons)
- **Cotyledons**: Yellowed/tan, wilted and discolored
- **Hypocotyl**: Appears brown and decayed at soil line
- **Soil**: Wet, dark — conditions typical of damping-off
- **Plant posture**: Collapsed/failing at soil line

This matches **Pythium_damping_off** closely — the reference image confirms the same pattern: young seedling with brown hypocotyl decay collapsing at soil level in wet conditions. The cotyledons in the test image are more yellowed/tan (slightly more advanced), but the overall damping-off presentation is the same.
